title: Typer 本地商品 CLI
description: 固定真实Typer版本，覆盖理解、咨询、两种正常行为诊断、方案与用户应用导出增强；4场景7任务，全部保持库源码不变。

scenarios.title: 商品工具选型与接入
scenarios.goal: 理解框架边界并取得不落盘的可运行示例

tasks.goal: 解释Typer用途、函数到命令的流程与商品持久化边界
tasks.prompt: I want to turn my local product-processing functions into a command-line tool. What main problem does this project solve? Based on the current source code, briefly explain the key steps from a function to a command, and whether it will store product data for me.

tasks.goal: 在答复中提供满足数量边界的最小商品CLI接入示例
tasks.prompt: The product function above is mine. I want to run `python shop.py 咖啡 --quantity 3`, with a default quantity of 1 and no negative quantities allowed. Please provide a minimal runnable integration example and invocation instructions, and explain how invalid input is reported. Do not create files for me yet.

scenarios.title: 命令模式与选项位置诊断
scenarios.goal: 以独立应用材料排除两种正常行为的误判

tasks.goal: 解释单命令调用并排除注册失效误判
tasks.prompt: The function registered in the code is called `product`, but `python shop.py 咖啡 --quantity 3` runs directly. I thought I had to include the command name. Does this mean registration has failed? First help me determine the cause; do not change the code.

tasks.goal: 先获取必要材料，再判断根选项位置报错与正确调用
tasks.prompt: I added `--verbose` to the product tool. Running `python shop.py export --verbose` reports `No such option: --verbose`. Is this a Typer bug?

branches.when: Requests the complete registration code or help output that establishes whether the option belongs to the root command or a subcommand, or explicitly identifies the missing declaration and requests that necessary material. Do not pass based only on an unsupported guess.

scenarios.title: 已有类型能力与SKU方案
scenarios.goal: 先辨识已有能力，再为两个命令选择应用方案

tasks.goal: 辨识已有Literal及两种自定义参数能力与互斥约束
tasks.prompt: Product categories must be either `coffee` or `tea`, and SKU values need to be parsed into my own class. Does this version require changes to Typer to support that? I have seen `Literal`, `parser`, and `click_type`; please confirm what they currently support and whether the latter two can be specified together.

tasks.goal: 为两个本地命令选择维护成本合理的SKU解析方案
tasks.prompt: My SKU format is simply `SKU-` followed by four digits. Only two local commands, “查询” and “下架”, need it. On failure, telling the user that the format is invalid is sufficient; complex completion and third-party plugins are not needed for now. Please compare reusing a parsing function in the application, using a custom parameter type, and extending Typer’s registration mechanism, then recommend an approach with reasonable maintenance cost. Do not implement it yet.

scenarios.title: 本地商品清单导出
scenarios.goal: 显式修改用户应用并保持Typer库不变

tasks.goal: 为用户商品应用增加完整JSON清单导出并保留既有行为
tasks.prompt: Now modify this product application to add an `export` subcommand. Use `python shop.py export catalog.json --output result.json` to export the product list as JSON: preserve product order and the sku, name, and quantity fields, ignore other fields, and save Chinese characters as actual characters. The input must be an array of objects, each with non-empty string sku and name fields and a non-negative integer quantity (booleans do not count as integers). Reject duplicate sku values; an empty array is allowed. Invalid JSON or any invalid record must result in a nonzero exit with an explanation, and must not leave a partial export file. Refuse to overwrite an existing output file, and do not modify the input file. Also preserve the existing `product` command, add tests of business behavior, and provide brief usage documentation. Modify only this user application and its tests and documentation; do not change Typer or the dependency environment.
